title: miniKanren - Dan Friedman and William Byrd
summary: Dan Friedman and William Byrd demonstrate miniKanren, a logic programming system for Scheme, in an unconference talk. It includes generating programs by running relations in reverse.
why: HN recommends it as a mind-blowing and fun introduction to logic programming for working programmers.

quote.text: I highly recommend watching Dan Friedman and William Byrd give their miniKanren conference talk
